name: ChatBI V2.1 Multiple Ground Truth Overlay
description: Execution-equivalent SQL ground truths. Runtime answers are still compared by executed values, never SQL text equality.

G01: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.revenue), 0) AS revenue FROM demo_business.orders o
G02: SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM demo_business.orders o
G03: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.cost), 0) AS cost FROM demo_business.orders o
G42: SELECT SUM(o.revenue) AS revenue, SUM(o.cost) AS cost, SUM(o.revenue) - SUM(o.cost) AS profit FROM demo_business.orders o
